name: Veracity
desc:
Administrative Assistant | $18.00-$23.00/hr | Data Entry Heavy, Minimal Phone
Company: Veracity Insurance
Industry: Insurance Services
What Your Day Will Look Like: You’d be the behind-the-scenes support for the account managers and brokers at an independent insurance company that serves small businesses. A lot of the day is preparing and processing paperwork like quotes, finance agreements, Accord applications, bind requests, invoices, and state affidavits. You’d also check policies, keep track of renewals, request loss runs, and enter transactions into the agency management system so the records stay accurate. On top of that, you’d cover shared inboxes and phones, schedule meetings, keep files organized, and watch deadlines for renewals and compliance filings. You’d also help train new admin staff and suggest ways to make the team’s work smoother. Part of the job is getting your Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance license.
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma required.
Required Experience: Minimum of 2 years in the surplus lines or insurance industry, or a valid P&C license with at least 1 year of related administrative or CSR experience. The posting ends that line with “preferred,” so confirm with the recruiter whether it’s required or preferred.
Preferred Experience: Background in administration or accounting. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Required Skills:
• Attention to detail and accuracy with quotes, invoices, and policy documents
• Willingness to obtain and maintain a P&C insurance license
• Professional demeanor with strong interpersonal and customer service skills
• Comfort using computer systems, email, and document management tools
• Organized, with the ability to track deadlines and keep files in order
• Reliable attendance and accountability
• Ability to keep information confidential
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
• Someone with insurance or administrative experience who wants a remote, behind-the-scenes role
• Someone who enjoys accuracy work like processing quotes, renewals, and invoices
• Someone willing to earn a P&C license (WRO may be able to help with this)
• Someone organized who likes tracking deadlines and keeping records tidy
Not a Good Fit for:
• Anyone with no insurance or administrative experience, since the posting lists two years in insurance or a license plus admin or CSR experience
• Anyone who doesn’t want to take a licensing exam
• Anyone who dislikes detail-heavy paperwork and data entry
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
• Insurance administrative support
• Quote and application processing
• Policy renewals and tracking
• Accurate data entry
• Invoice and billing processing
• Document and file management
• Calendar and meeting coordination
• Audit documentation support
• Customer service
• Attention to detail
4-5 interview questions for this role:
• Tell us about your insurance or administrative experience and what you handled day to day.
• How do you keep quotes, invoices, and policy documents accurate when you’re working fast?
• How do you keep track of deadlines like renewals and compliance filings?
• How do you feel about getting your Property & Casualty license?
• Walk us through how you’d help train a new team member on a process you know well.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18/hr to $23/hr, confirmed in posting.
Shift: Not stated in posting. Confirm directly.
Benefits: Health, dental, and vision plans, 4 weeks of paid time off, 10 paid company holidays plus 2 floating holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, and personal assistance programs.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: No.
Drug Test: Certain positions.
Notes: The posting says remote but doesn’t list eligible states, so confirm Oklahoma is covered. Getting a P&C insurance license is part of the job, and WRO may be able to help with it, so participants should talk to their coach. The benefits are strong for an admin role, with 4 weeks of paid time off, 10 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays, and a 401(k) match. Veracity is an independent insurance company that serves small businesses, and the role works directly with account managers and brokers.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting, though the role includes guiding peers, helping with training, and working on special projects. Reasonable inferred path: Administrative Assistant → Senior Administrative Assistant → Account Manager → Insurance Billing and Processing Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Veracity directly.
